mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 30 days predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates on equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 30 days, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) falls below 1.5%, it signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 1.5, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both rise by more than 0.5% over the past 30 days, it signals moderate inflation with strong growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where INDPRO and CPIAUCSL both rise >0.5% over 30 days, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (defined by UNRATE > 4.0% and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% over two quarters), a rise in the labor force (PAYEMS) over the past 30 days signals labor market recovery, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: recession (UNRATE > 4.0% and GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in 2 quarters)
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises in the defined recession, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 30 days predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to strengthening consumer demand and confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST rises over 30 days, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals deteriorating housing market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) both rise by more than 0.5% over the past 30 days, it signals robust demand and supply conditions, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both rise >0.5% over 30 days, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 2.5% annually, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL growth > 2.5% and INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
